## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. ## How to run it

### Through an API

api (Z.AI) · $0.24/M blended · $0.15 in / $0.5 out per 1M tokens · [docs.z.ai](https://docs.z.ai/guides/overview/pricing)

<sub>[price source](https://github.com/anomalyco/models.dev/blob/a668908cfe7073faa0363699486fc41a3ff52412/providers/zai/models/glm-5.3-flash.toml): Standard base token rate from models.dev. Provider-specific tiers, long-context surcharges, caching and promotions may differ. · [context source](https://github.com/anomalyco/models.dev/blob/a668908cfe7073faa0363699486fc41a3ff52412/models/zhipuai/glm-5.3-flash.toml)</sub>

### llama.cpp (recommended)

1. Install llama.cpp. Homebrew and winget installs name the commands llama-cli and llama-server instead. [Other ways to install](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/install.md)
   
   ```sh
   # macOS / Linux
   curl -LsSf https://llama.app/install.sh | sh
   # Windows
   irm https://llama.app/install.ps1 | iex
   ```

2. Run GLM-5.3-Flash (ud-q4_k_xl, needs ~192.5 GB, from [huggingface.co/unsloth](https://huggingface.co/unsloth/GLM-5.3-Flash-GGUF/tree/main))
   
   ```sh
   llama cli -hf unsloth/GLM-5.3-Flash-GGUF:UD-Q4_K_XL
   ```

3. Or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
   
   ```sh
   llama serve -hf unsloth/GLM-5.3-Flash-GGUF:UD-Q4_K_XL
   ```

Other versions: ud-q2_k_xl (~96.5 GB) `llama cli -hf unsloth/GLM-5.3-Flash-GGUF:UD-Q2_K_XL`

### LM Studio

1. Install LM Studio. Open the app once before using the lms command. [Download it (macOS / Windows / Linux)](https://lmstudio.ai/download)

2. Run GLM-5.3-Flash (ud-q4_k_xl, needs ~192.5 GB, from [huggingface.co/unsloth](https://huggingface.co/unsloth/GLM-5.3-Flash-GGUF/tree/main))
   
   ```sh
   lms get https://huggingface.co/unsloth/GLM-5.3-Flash-GGUF@UD-Q4_K_XL -y
   ```

3. Then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name

Other versions: ud-q2_k_xl (~96.5 GB) `lms get https://huggingface.co/unsloth/GLM-5.3-Flash-GGUF@UD-Q2_K_XL -y`

Official weights and documentation: [huggingface.co/zai-org](https://huggingface.co/zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash)
